# U104: Reviews off, then back on: off, Home is Home without reviews; back on, every review is as it was, and none whose date passed while it was off says Not held yet

- **Belongs to:** the Reviews module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `REVIEWS-OPTIONAL`, `MODULES`
- **Budget:** at most 10 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `entry`, `parity` ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/reviews` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U104

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- Go to `/reviews` in the demo.
- **Check:** The list of reviews shows.
- Go to `/workspace/features` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “Reviews” tick box.
- **Step.** Press the “Switch off Reviews” button.
- **Check:** “Reviews is off in” is shown.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “off”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** Home shows.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `!(await p.locator('.dash-review').count()) && !/Not held yet|Review today|Open the review/.test(await p.locator('[data-part="Home"]').innerText())`. Else it says: Home with Reviews off still names a review.
- _Note:_ Back on: switching on acts at once.
- Go to `/workspace/features` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “Reviews” tick box.
- **Check:** “Reviews is on in” is shown.
- **Check:** (`one-action`) scored as met here.
- Go to `/reviews` in the demo.
- **Check:** The list of reviews shows.
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** Home shows.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `after === before && after > 0 && !notHeld`, where `const before = (await p.locator('main').innerText()).match(/Platform leadership weekly|Quarterly business review/g)?.length ?? 0`; `const after = (await p.locator('main').innerText()).match(/Platform leadership weekly|Quarterly business review/g)?.length ?? 0`; `const notHeld = /Not held yet/.test(await p.locator('[data-part="Home"]').innerText())`. Else it says: back on: Reviews lists {after} of the {before} it listed before{worked out in the journey as `notHeld ? '; Home says a session is Not held yet' : ''`}.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `s.changes.some((c) => c.entity === 'workspace' && c.summary === 'Switched off Reviews') && s.changes.some((c) => c.entity === 'workspace' && c.summary === 'Switched on Reviews')`, where `const s = await h.snapshot()`. Else it says: switching Reviews off and on was not logged.
- **Check:** (`progress`) scored as met here.
- **Check:** (`errors`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
